records.text_span: Rock Rapids, Rock Valley, Hawarden, Spencer, Sioux Rapids, Cherokee experienced widespread flooding.
All residents north of Highway 18 ordered to evacuate.
Approximately 20 rescues conducted; crews from Sioux City Fire Rescue and Iowa Task Force 1 deployed; trucks, boats, and tractors used.

records.text_span: Levee broke around 1 a.m. Saturday.
City without power and water.
The river rose to historic levels that we've never seen here before; river reached 22 feet, previous 2014 flood was approximately 16 feet.
